title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität – Festnahmen wegen versuchten Mordes, Erpressung und des Verstoßes gegen das Waffengesetz

extraction.summaryEn: Police arrested a 21-year-old suspected of shooting at a café window in Neukölln in April 2026, linked to a protection-money demand, and seized two firearms during raids at seven addresses. The attempted murder suspect was brought before an investigating judge and remanded in custody.
